title: Steelers invite 300 pound punter to rookie minicamp

sources.title: Steelers invite 300 pound punter to rookie minicamp
sources.description: The Pittsburgh Steelers made a splash in the 2026 NFL Draft when they selected Penn State quarterback Drew Allar in the third round. Now, they are brining one of his teammates with him to rookie minicamp. Pittsburgh has invited punter Gabe Nwosu to their rookie minicamp, per the Senior Specialist All-Star Game.
